meta.health_warning: Three standing warnings from research/01 §6.  (1) The harness is worth more than the model: flipping two API settings took GPT-5.6 Sol from 13.3% to 38.3% on ARC-AGI-3, same model. (2) Anthropic evaluates with production safeguards ON, scoring zero where a classifier fires, while comparison models run with them off -- published Claude scores understate raw capability.  (3) Composite indices refit globally and are not comparable across versions: Artificial Analysis moved Fable 5.1 through 65.7 -> 57 -> 53 in two weeks for the same model.
